name: tree
title: File Tree
blurb: Hierarchical file-tree UI with folder expansion, selection, and keyboard…
description: Renders a tree structure using @headless-tree for state management. Supports expand/collapse, item selection, drag indicators, and keyboard shortcuts. Context-driven sub-components handle items and labels.
use_when: File explorers, hierarchical navigation, or project structure views with keyboard interaction.
avoid_when: Simple flat lists; this requires @headless-tree and complex state setup.
a11y: Items have aria-expanded. Focus management via data-focus attribute. Keyboard navigation depends on tree instance.
